subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can name shapes: circle, square, triangle and rectangle.
I can count the sides of a shape.
I can find shapes around me and say: It's a circle.

tf.why: Great! A square has four sides.
A circle has no corners. It is round.
Yes! The whiteboard is a rectangle.

tf.s: A square has four sides the same.
tf.why: Right! All four sides of a square are the same.
A circle is round. A triangle has three sides.

tf.s: We ask What shape is it? about a shape.
tf.why: Yes! What shape is it? It's a circle.

tf.s: We can find shapes in the classroom.
tf.why: Yes! The whiteboard is a rectangle.

tf.s: The moon in the picture is a triangle.
tf.why: The moon in the picture is a circle.

boxes.q: How many sides has a triangle?

boxes.why: A circle is round with no corners.

boxes.q: How many sides has a rectangle?
Which shape has four sides the same?
boxes.why: A square has four sides the same.

boxes.q: What shape is the moon in the picture?
boxes.why: The moon in the picture is a circle.

boxes.q: Which question asks about a shape?
boxes.why: What shape is it? asks about the shape.

boxes.q: Is it a circle? (a round shape)
boxes.why: A round shape is a circle.

boxes.q: The square is red. What colour is the square?
Which shapes are in the house picture?
boxes.why: The house has a square and a triangle.

mcq.q: How many corners has a rectangle?
Which word is NOT a shape?
mcq.why: A teddy is a toy, not a shape.

mcq.q: Your teacher points to the whiteboard. What shape is it?
A shape has 3 sides and 3 corners. What is it?
mcq.why: Three sides and three corners make a triangle.

mcq.q: The circle is blue. What colour is the circle?
mcq.why: The circle is blue tells the colour.

mcq.q: How is a square different from a rectangle?
o: A square has four sides the same.
mcq.why: All four sides of a square are the same.

mcq.q: Which shape is NOT like the others: square, rectangle, circle, triangle?
mcq.why: A circle has no sides or corners. The others do.

mcq.q: A house picture has a roof and a wall. Which shapes do you see?
mcq.why: The roof is a triangle. The house is a square.
